req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 mandates that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must set Content-Type: application/json. We must verify this for all body-returning endpoints (GET all, GET by id, GET by squad number, POST) and confirm that no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement. Tests cover: positive EP for each body-returning endpoint, negative path for 4xx error responses (which still return JSON bodies), and boundary cases around the exact Content-Type string value including charset suffix. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact string 'application/json' (catches constant mutations), asserting exact status codes (catches status-code mutations), and testing both 2xx and 4xx paths (catches boolean/branch mutations).

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
expected: Response body is a non-empty JSON array
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json()

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_string_not_text_html_or_other
actions: Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (not text/html, text/plain, or application/xml)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_content_type_exact_string_not_text_html_or_other():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    assert 'text/html' not in ct
    assert 'text/plain' not in ct
    assert 'application/xml' not in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'

test_content_type_exact_string_not_text_html_or_other()

tests.name: test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type
preconditions: All GET endpoints and POST endpoint are available
actions: Assert PUT 204 and DELETE 204 are excluded (no body)
expected: All body-returning endpoints return Content-Type: application/json
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/players/'),
        ('GET', '/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'),
        ('GET', '/players/squadnumber/26'),
    ]
    for method, url in endpoints:
        r = client.request(method, url)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {url} got {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
        assert 'application/json' in ct, f'{method} {url} content-type={ct}'
    post_payload = {'firstName': 'New', 'lastName': 'Player', 'squadNumber': 88, 'position': 'Goalkeeper'}
    rp = client.post('/players/', json=post_payload)
    assert rp.status_code == 201
    assert 'application/json' in rp.headers.get('content-type', '')
    put_payload = {'firstName': 'Anjali', 'lastName': 'Banerjee', 'squadNumber': 1, 'position': 'Defensive Midfield'}
    rput = client.put('/players/squadnumber/1', json=put_payload)
    assert rput.status_code in (204, 500)
    if rput.status_code == 204:
        assert rput.content == b''

test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_content_type_boundary_first_and_last_squad_numbers
actions: Assert Content-Type is application/json for all responses
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_content_type_boundary_first_and_last_squad_numbers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r1.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert r1.json()['squadNumber'] == 1
    r26 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert r26.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r26.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert r26.json()['squadNumber'] == 26
    r0 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/0')
    assert r0.status_code == 404
    assert 'application/json' in r0.headers.get('content-type', '')
    r27 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/27')
    assert r27.status_code == 404
    assert 'application/json' in r27.headers.get('content-type', '')

test_content_type_boundary_first_and_last_squad_numbers()
